classificationThresholdStatus: exploratory rules fixed before inference; user accuracy review pending

vad.channelPolicy: highest whole-track RMS channel; the other channel is not independently assessed

frames.method: input seeking with showinfo actual source timestamps; no earlier frame cache

textDetection.smallEdgeCandidate: area <=2.5% and height <=6%, center in outer 10% vertical or 12% horizontal
textDetection.textEvidence: at least 2 of 8 frames retain geometric text candidates
textDetection.overlayHeuristic: geometry only; cannot prove watermark identity

visualChange.scope: differences between eight sparse samples, not continuous motion or semantic change

labels.speech: 口播主导或口播加图文

classification: speech fraction >=60% and speech in >=50% of timeline bins: speech category, strong rule evidence
speech fraction >10%: speech category candidate, moderate/low rule evidence
zero speech and >=2 retained text frames: visual-text category
speech fraction <=10% and <2 retained text frames: visual category candidate (sparse voice allowed)
speech fraction >0% and <=10% and >=2 retained text frames: unresolved boundary; no forced fourth category
